dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Well, this is an unexpected reunion.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Like three stars of different colors rising in the same sky — what a spectacular occasion!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Archon, and Miss Nilou from the Zubayr Theater! I—I'm... not interrupting anything, am I?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Of course not! I'm just relaxing, gazing up at the starry sky. I get a lot of inspiration for new dances when I come here.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh! I'm also here to get some inspiration. I thought I was the only one who did that...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Of course, the inspiration I need has to do with my studies...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Well, we might be searching for different things, but in the end, we're both just waiting for that spark to strike.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, but this time, it wasn't inspiration, but Lesser Lord Kusanali who came knocking instead.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: How do you know I'm not here searching for that same spark?

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: We must innovate, after all, even in dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Here, I brought some Candied Ajilenakh Nuts. May they bring us all sweet dreams.
